Approach

Research-led

Every project starts with questions, from interviews and market studies to documentaries and archives.

Rooted in culture

Konkan kitchens, Naga tattoo traditions, Rangoli, Jaipur’s palaces: heritage reinterpreted, never copied.

Made by hand

About

Hello, I’m Dhruti.

I’m a designer in Mumbai, and a lot of my work begins with where I come from.

I grew up with roots in a small village on the Konkan coast, and the flavours, rituals and memories of home keep finding their way into my projects. My work moves between brand identity, packaging, editorial and publication design, and film.

I like to start with research, interviews and questions, then turn what I find into something people can hold, read and remember.
